answer_1.quote: We used few-shot prompting with GPT-4o to generate questions regarding descriptive statistics, point-wise comparisons, and trend analysis.

answer_2.quote: To assess the similarity between the LVLM attention maps and the human attention maps, we used three standard metrics commonly used in saliency prediction (Meur and Baccino, 2012; Bruckert et al., 2021). Pearson's Correlation Coefficient (CC), Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence, and histogram intersection (also known as similarity or SIM metric)...

answer_4.quote: We had human annotators flag ambiguous or incorrect questions during data collection... We also verified the quality of the GPT-generated answers by measuring agreement with human annotators.
answer_4.guideline: human annotators were instructed to flag ambiguous or incorrect questions and verify answer correctness
